channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in Jensen Huang u diiday inuu ogaa in haweeneydu basaasad Shiine ahayd
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu Isniintii la hadlay madaxa Nvidia Jensen Huang, kaasoo u diiday inuu ogaa in haweeneyda uu xiriirka la lahaa ay ahayd basaasad Shiine ah, sida ay CNN sheegtay.

item.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo Buenos Aires kula kulmay shan qof oo ka badbaaday xadgudub wadaaddo
item.description: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa maalintii labaad ee booqashadiisa Argentina si gaar ah ula kulmay shan qof oo ka badbaaday xadgudubyo galmo oo ay geysteen wadaaddo, wuxuuna ballanqaaday inuu xoojiyo ilaalinta, sida ay Al Jazeera sheegtay.

item.title: Tom Brady oo joojiyay xiriirkiisii kooxda Birmingham City
item.description: Halyeeyga NFL-ka Tom Brady ayaa soo afjaray xiriirkiisii kooxda Birmingham City oo hoggaanka u haysa horyaalka Championship, 3 sano kadib, sida ay BBC Sport iyo The Athletic sheegeen.

item.title: Falanqeyn: Iskaashiga milatari ee Türkiye wuxuu Soomaaliya ka caawin karaa inay amnigeeda gacanteeda ku qabato, sida uu qoray Dr. Ismaaciil Cali Shiikhnuur
item.description: Dr. Ismaaciil Cali Shiikhnuur, oo horey u ahaa madaxa shaqaalaha Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, ayaa falanqayn uu qoray ku sheegay in iskaashiga milatari ee Türkiye uu Soomaaliya ka caawin karo inay buuxiso haldaloolada amni ee ka dhalan kara baxa ciidamada Uganda iyo isbeddelka howlgalka Midowga Afrika, balse uu ku adkaystay in Türkiye ay tahay saaxiib dhisa awoodda, ee aysan beddel u ahayn ciidamada qaranka.

item.title: Erdogan: Turkiga wuxuu Gabar ka helay laba goobood oo saliid ah oo cusub
item.description: Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdogan ayaa sheegay in Turkiga uu helay laba goobood oo saliid ah oo cusub oo ku yaalla gobolka Gabar ee koonfur-bari, kuwaas oo lagu qiyaasay 135 milyan oo foosto, sida ay Türkiye Today sheegtay.

item.title: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Qubrus oo isku raacay furitaanka laba marin oo cusub oo xadka jasiiradda ah
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Giriigga Qubrus Nikos Christodoulides iyo hoggaamiyaha Turkiga Qubrus Tufan Erhurman ayaa ku heshiiyay inay furaan laba marin oo cusub oo ka gudba xariiqda kala qaybisa jasiiradda, sida ay Al Jazeera sheegtay.

item.title: Arsène Wenger oo go'aan kama dambays ah ka gaaraya inuu la tartamo Infantino doorashada FIFA
item.description: Arsène Wenger, tababarihii hore ee Arsenal, ayaa ku dhow inuu go'aan kama dambays ah ka gaaro inuu u tartamo madaxweynaha FIFA isagoo la tartamaya Gianni Infantino, iyadoo heshiiska shaqo ee uu FIFA kula jiro uu dhammaanayo dhammaadka sannadkan, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic.

item.title: Lauren Boebert oo lumisay kursigeeda Congress-ka, sida ay CNN saadaalisay
item.description: Xildhibaanad Lauren Boebert oo ka tirsan Xisbiga Jamhuuriga ayaa lumisay doorashada degmada 4aad ee gobolka Colorado, halkaas oo ay ku guuleysatay Eileen Laubacher oo ah Dimuqraadi iyo sarkaal hore oo ciidanka badda Mareykanka ah, sida ay saadaalisay Desk-ga Go'aanka ee CNN.

item.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Mareykanka oo u oggolaatay Trump inuu sii wado dhismaha darbiga Big Bend ee Texas
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Mareykanka ayaa meesha ka saartay amar maxkamad hoose oo hakiyay dhismaha darbiga xuduudda iyo kaabeyaasha la xiriira ee gobolka Big Bend ee Texas, inta dacwaddu socoto, sida ay wariyeen CNN iyo CBS News.

item.title: Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya ku daray 23-ka waddan ee heerka 4aad ee digniinta safarka
item.description: Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Mareykanka ayaa ogeysiis ay Isniintii 9 November soo saartay ku sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay 23 waddan oo lagu daray heerka ugu sarreeya ee digniinta safarka, Heerka 4aad ee "Ha u safrin", sida ay wariyeen Caasimada Online iyo Eye Radio.

item.title: Qarax ka dhacay warshad bir oo ku taal galbeedka Turkiga oo dilay ugu yaraan 16 qof
item.description: Ugu yaraan 16 qof ayaa ku dhimatay 13 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen qarax Isniintii duhurkii ka dhacay warshadda birta ee Habaş ee degmada Aliağa, waqooyiga magaalada Izmir, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha Turkiga; Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa ku dhawaaqay baaritaan.

item.title: Koonfur Afrika oo xirtay 9 ajnabi oo looga shakisan yahay inay u socdeen ciidamada Ruushka
item.description: Booliska Koonfur Afrika ayaa sheegay in sagaal ajnabi ah oo da'doodu u dhaxayso 20 ilaa 26 sano lagu xiray garoonka OR Tambo ee Johannesburg iyo hoteel u dhow, iyagoo looga shakisan yahay inay u socdeen Ruushka si ay ugu dagaalamaan dagaalka Ukraine, sida ay wariyeen Al Jazeera iyo AP.

item.title: Holstein Kiel oo shaqada ka eriday tababaraha Tim Walter
item.description: Kooxda Holstein Kiel ayaa shaqada ka eriday tababaraheeda Tim Walter oo 51 jir ah, kadib hal guul oo keliya 11 kulan oo ay kooxdu ku jirto kaalinta ugu hooseysa ee 2. Bundesliga, sida ay sheegtay bogga rasmiga ah ee Bundesliga.

item.title: Garabka England Immanuel Feyi-Waboso oo ka maqnaan doona inta ka hartay Nations Championship
item.description: Immanuel Feyi-Waboso, 23 jir, ayaa ka maqnaan doona inta ka hartay tartanka Nations Championship kadib dhaawac canqowga ah oo uu ka soo gaaray guushii England ay 45-22 kaga adkaatay Australia, sida ay werisay BBC Sport. England ayaa sidoo kale kulanka Japan ee Sabtida ku seegi doonta Seb Atkinson, Ollie Chessum iyo George Furbank.

item.title: Kenya: Ruto oo Lydia Chelagat u magacaabay Guddoomiyaha Ilaalinta Xogta, shan hay'adood oo helay maamulayaal cusub
item.description: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa Lydia Sitienei Chelagat u magacaabay xilka Guddoomiyaha Ilaalinta Xogta (Data Commissioner), magaceedana u gudbiyay Golaha Qaranka si loo ansixiyo, sida ay werisay KBC oo ah warbaahinta dowladda. Isla markaana shan hay'adood oo dowladeed, oo ay ku jiraan Hay'adda Hantida Dowladda la Iibinayo iyo Hay'adda La-dagaallanka Daroogada Ciyaaraha (ADAK), ayaa ku dhawaaqay maamulayaal cusub.

item.title: Wargeyska baaritaannada ee Ruushka Novaya Gazeta oo xirmay kadib cadaadis dowladeed
item.description: Wargeyska Novaya Gazeta, oo ka mid ahaa warbaahinta yar ee Ruushka ku hartay ee dhaleeceysa dagaalka Ukraine, ayaa Isniintii qabtay kulankiisii ugu dambeeyay ee tifaftirka oo xiray xafiiskiisa, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera. Wargeyska ayaa horay u sheegay in lagu qasbay xiritaanka kadib markii Moscow ay ku tilmaantay "wakiil shisheeye".

item.title: Xildhibaan Jamhuuri ah Thomas Massie oo ku qasbaya codbixin lagu xil ka qaadayo Wasiirka Difaaca Hegseth
item.description: Xildhibaanka Jamhuuriga Thomas Massie ayaa sheegay inuu toddobaadkan Aqalka Wakiillada ku qasbi doono codbixin lagu xil ka qaadayo Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth, isagoo ku eedeeyay inuu jebiyay dastuurka maadaama uu dagaal ka waday Iran in ka badan 90 maalmood oggolaansho Congress la'aan, sida ay werisay BBC. Dadaalkan ayaa la filayaa inuu fashilmo.

item.title: Meta oo adduunka oo dhan ka bilaabaysa hubin da'da dhalinyarada ah oo lagu sameeyo AI
item.description: Shirkadda Meta ayaa sheegtay in bishan ay Instagram ka bilaabayso tiknoolajiyad AI ah oo qiyaasta da'da, si ay u hesho dhalinyarada isticmaala taariikh dhalasho oo qof weyn ah oo ay ugu wareejiso Teen Accounts, kadibna ay ku fidinayso Facebook iyo Threads, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Uganda: Maalgelin la'aan ayaa dib u dhigaysa ka guurista isticmaalka meerkuriga ee macdan qodista dahabka
item.description: Daneeyayaal ku shiray Kampala shirka sannadlaha ah ee planetGOLD Uganda ayaa sheegay in maalgelin la'aan ay ka hor istaagayso macdan qodayaasha yaryar inay iibsadaan qalab ammaan ah oo aan meerkuri isticmaalin, sida ay werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Mareykanka oo Rwanda u celiyay Jean Léonard Teganya oo lagu eedeeyay xasuuqii 1994
item.description: Hay'adda Xeer-ilaalinta Qaranka Rwanda ayaa sheegtay in 9 November 2026 ay gacanta ku dhigtay Jean Léonard Teganya oo Mareykanka laga soo masaafuriyay, kaasoo looga baahan yahay eedeymo la xiriira xasuuqii 1994 iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah aadanaha oo lagu sheegay inay ka dhaceen Butare; diyaaraddii siday ayaa ku degtay Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Kigali qiyaastii 6-dii fiidnimo, sida uu wariyay KT Press.

item.title: Uganda oo maalgashadayaal shisheeye u raadinaysa ballaarinta wax-soo-saarka iyo warshadaynta bunka
item.description: Dowladda Uganda ayaa sheegtay inay higsanayso 20 milyan oo kiish oo bun ah sannadkii marka la gaaro 2030, ayna maalgashadayaal shisheeye ka raadinayso waraabka, beeraha ganacsiga iyo warshadaynta gudaha; bunku wuxuu dalka u keenaa qiyaastii 24% dakhliga lacagta qalaad, sida uu wariyay Nile Post.

item.title: Museveni oo xilalkooda ku sii hayay Yunus Kakande iyo 15 xoghaye oo joogto ah
item.description: Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni ayaa Hajji Yunus Kakande ku sii hayay xilka Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Xafiiska Madaxweynaha, isagoo ka mid ah 16 xoghaye oo joogto ah oo xilalkooda sii haya magacaabistii ugu dambeysay; Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Milly Babalanda ayaa sheegtay in go'aankaasi muujinayo kalsoonida Madaxweynaha, sida uu wariyay Nile Post.

item.title: Carlos Vicens oo si rasmi ah loogu magacaabay tababaraha Olympique Lyonnais
item.description: Tababaraha reer Spain Carlos Vicens oo 43 jir ah ayaa heshiis hal sano iyo bar ah la saxiixday Olympique Lyonnais, wuxuuna bedelayaa Paulo Fonseca oo dhowaan u dhaqaaqay Sporting, sida ay wariyeen L'Équipe iyo Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Sassuolo oo xilka ka qaaday tababare Alberto Aquilani wax ka yar 5 bilood kadib
item.description: Kooxda Sassuolo ee Serie A ayaa 9 November xilka ka qaaday Alberto Aquilani oo la magacaabay bishii June, kadib markii ay guuldarraystay 6 ka mid ah 7-dii kulan ee u dambeeyay, ayna ku dhowdahay goobta hoos u dhaca; waa tababarihii 6-aad ee Talyaaniga laga eryo 11 wareeg gudahood, sida ay wariyeen L'Équipe iyo Mundo Deportivo.

item.title: Faransiiska oo Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ku eedeeyay weerarkii internetka ee qaboojiyeyaasha suuqyada
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Faransiiska Jean-Noël Barrot ayaa Isniintii ku eedeeyay Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran weerarkii internetka ee bishii hore gaaray qaboojiyeyaasha suuqyada, kaas oo sababay in cuntada cusub ay ku xumaato ilaa 700 dukaan, isagoo ku tilmaamay weerar baaxaddiisa iyo gardarradiisa aan horay loo arag; wuxuu sheegay in Faransiisku uu doonayo cunaqabateyn heer Yurub ah, sida ay wariyeen CNN iyo BBC.

item.title: Raúl, halyeygii Real Madrid, oo loo magacaabay tababaraha Real Oviedo
item.description: Weeraryahankii hore ee Real Madrid Raúl González oo 49 jir ah ayaa loo magacaabay tababaraha kooxda Real Oviedo ee ka ciyaarta heerka 2-aad ee Spain, isagoo saxiixay heshiis ilaa June 2028; wuxuu bedelay Julián Calero oo Isniintii la eryay iyadoo kooxdu ay kaalinta 9-aad ku jirto, sida uu wariyay BBC Sport.

item.title: Kenya: Kindiki oo sheegay in aan gobol ka liito gobol kale, Taita Taveta-na u ballanqaaday horumar
item.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Kenya Kithure Kindiki ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ay si siman u qaybin doonto kheyraadka qaranka iyadoo aan loo eegin taageerada siyaasadeed ee gobollada, isagoo ballanqaaday maalgelin horumarineed oo dheeraad ah oo loogu talagalay degmada Taita Taveta oo muddo dheer la dayacay; wuxuu sheegay in mabda'a 'Usawa ni Sawa' uu salka u yahay ajandaha dib-u-doorashada Madaxweyne William Ruto, sida ay wariyeen Capital FM iyo KBC.

item.title: Kenya: Duale iyo WHO oo dib u eegay jawaabta Ebola kadib 3 toddobaad oo aan kiis cusub lahayn
item.description: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Kenya Aden Duale ayaa kulan la yeeshay ergo ka socota Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) oo uu hoggaaminayo Agaasimaha Gobolka Afrika, si ay dib ugu eegaan jawaabta Kenya ee cudurka Ebola nooca Bundibugyo ee dibadda ka yimid, iyadoo dalku diiwaangeliyay 3 toddobaad oo xiriir ah oo aan kiis cusub oo la xaqiijiyay lahayn, sida uu wariyay KBC (warbaahinta dowladda).

item.title: Pau Cubarsí oo ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Golden Boy 2026
item.description: Daafaca Barcelona Pau Cubarsí oo 19 jir ah ayaa loo doortay Golden Boy 2026, abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican Yurub ee ka yar 21 sano oo uu bixiyo wargeyska Talyaaniga ee Tuttosport, isagoo ka horreeyay Yan Diomande iyo Warren Zaire-Emery; waa ciyaaryahankii 5-aad ee Barcelona ee ku guuleysta kadib Messi, Pedri, Gavi iyo Lamine Yamal, sida ay wariyeen Mundo Deportivo iyo Sky Sport Italia.

item.title: Trump oo shaki geliyay natiijada doorashada xilliga dhexe, kadib markii uu horay u sheegay inuu aqbalayo
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii bartiisa Truth Social ku weydiiyay haddii uu jiro qof rumeysan in doorashadan ay daacad ahayd, isagoo aan caddeyn keenin, kadib markii Dimuqraadiyiintu ay dib ula wareegeen labada aqal ee Kongareeska; habeenkii doorashada wuxuu u sheegay New York Times inuu gabi ahaanba diyaar u yahay inuu aqbalo natiijada, sida ay wariyeen BBC iyo Türkiye Today.
